title.narrative: Women economic empowerment for inclusive and sustainable growth

description.narrative: The initiative will be implemented through a consortium composed of UN Women and UNIDO, with UN Women acting as the lead agency. The project responds to the needs of Egypt#s post revolution transition with its focus on economic growth and social justice and is aligned with the GoE's recently launched Sustainable Development Strategy (SDS) 2030. The project also responds to the demands of women as articulated after the revolution in the Egyptian Women#s Charter. The objective is to increase women#s effective economic participation and empowerment within the context of sustainable development. The initiative is expected to result in enhanced participation of women in high growth high impact sectors of agribusiness, creative industries, energy, tourism, and IT; in increased productivity of businesses in the sectors of focus; in the strengthened ability of women led businesses to attract and retain workers (women and men); in the increased employment of women by businesses as well as in the enhanced employability of women in the sectors of focus and their ability to benefit from engendered corporate policies. The primary target of the project is women; however, the interventions proposed includes men as implementers and beneficiaries.
